cands.name: Felipe Sousa Lazaballet
cands.bio: Executive director of the HOPE CommUnity Center, age 40. Born in Brazil, undocumented for 15 years, U.S. citizen since 2021. Political newcomer with a St. Thomas University business degree. Spelled "Sousa-Lazaballet" in most news coverage.
cands.local_ties: Orlando-area nonprofit leader; the district covers Winter Park, Maitland, Eatonville and part of Orlando (Florida Politics).

record.text: Qualified for the ballot by collecting petition signatures; his campaign says he would be the first Dreamer elected to the Legislature.

money_notes.text: Raised more than $360,000 through his campaign and his political committee, Thriving Together (Florida Politics, Oct. 25, 2026).

endorsements.text: Anna Eskamani, Orlando Mayor Buddy Dyer, U.S. Rep. Maxwell Frost, Sen. Carlos Guillermo Smith, Orange County Classroom Teachers Association, Orlando Professional Fire Fighters, Central Florida Hotel and Lodging Association PAC, Unite Here locals; Orlando Sentinel editorial board.
Florida AFL-CIO, Florida NOW, Save Split Oak, Florida Hispanic Chamber of Commerce, Rainbow Democrats, MomsRising Together.

cands.gaps: Photo is a campaign-site image. Owner sources: only alexjoneslive.com on-site search was run for this name (no results); stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com on-site searches are bot-blocked and the web-search budget ran out, so those were not checked.

cands.name: Bonnie Jackson
cands.bio: Attorney, 63; former Assistant District Attorney in Houston and founder of Jackson Law Firm with her husband. Texas A&M B.B.A., South Texas College of Law J.D. Lost the 2022 HD 42 race to Anna Eskamani (43%).
cands.local_ties: Winter Park resident; says she has called HD 42 home for nearly 30 years (campaign site, Florida Politics).

record.text: Ran for HD 42 in 2022 and lost to Eskamani with 43% of the vote.

money_notes.text: Raised nearly $52,000 and lent her campaign $25,000 (Florida Politics, Oct. 25, 2026).

endorsements.text: Sen. Jason Brodeur; Reps. Doug Bankson, Erika Booth, Rachel Plakon, Susan Plasencia, Paula Stark; Florida Fraternal Order of Police, Florida Family Action, Conservative Ministers of Orange County.
